nodes.name: Mo2C Precursor Synthesis
nodes.procedure: A mixture of ammonium molybdate tetrahydrate and ethylenediamine was reacted at 150 °C for 12 h under suitable pH values adjusted using acetic acid. The above precursor was calcinated at 450 °C for 2 h under a 5% H2/N2 atmosphere to acquire Mo2C NSs.

nodes.source_text: First, a mixture of ammonium molybdate tetrahydrate and ethylenediamine was reacted at 150 °C for 12 h under suitable pH values adjusted using acetic acid. The above precursor was calcinated at 450 °C for 2 h under a 5% H2/N2 atmosphere to acquire Mo2C NSs.

nodes.name: Ru Wet Impregnation
nodes.procedure: The as-prepared Mo2C NSs were impregnated with a solution including RuCl3·xH2O at a concentration of 1.6 mM at room temperature for 24 h.

nodes.description: HER performance in N₂-saturated 1.0 M KOH using three-electrode system
nodes.source_text: The electrochemical HER performance of Ru₁–Mo₂C NSs was evaluated in N₂-saturated 1.0 M KOH electrolyte with a typical three-electrode system... the required overpotentials at the current density of 10 mA cm⁻² (η₁₀) and 100 mA cm⁻² (η₁₀₀) for the Ru₁–Mo₂C NSs are 10.8 mV and 56.8 mV... Tafel slope of the Ru₁–Mo₂C NSs is 38.5 mV dec⁻¹... smaller charge transfer resistance (R_ct) of 1.03 Ω... C_dl for the Ru₁–Mo₂C NSs was 31.8 mF cm⁻²... exchange current density of the Ru₁–Mo₂C NSs is 4.04 mA cm⁻²... ultrahigh TOF value of 3.16 H₂ s⁻¹ and mass activity of 8.67 A mgPGM⁻¹ under an overpotential of 100 mV

nodes.description: HER stability testing in 1.0 M KOH - cycling and chronoamperometry
nodes.source_text: A continuous cycling test was conducted at a potential range from 0.05 V to -0.2 V... the HER activity of the Ru₁–Mo₂C NSs showed negligible attenuation after 10 000 continuous cycles... long-term chronoamperometry at the potential of -56.8 mV... current density of Ru₁–Mo₂C NSs was well maintained even after 140 h

nodes.description: AEMWE performance with Ru₁–Mo₂C as cathodic catalyst at 65°C
nodes.source_text: an alkaline exchange membrane water electrolysis (AEMWE) device was constructed with Ru₁–Mo₂C as the cathodic catalyst... achieved industrial-level current densities of 1.0 and 2.0 A cm⁻² at low cell voltages of 1.83 and 2.03 V... maintained a consistent voltage of approximately 1.70 V with no significant increase over 200 hours of continuous operation at an industrial current density of 500 mA cm⁻²

nodes.characterization_summary: SEM shows curled nanosheet structure maintained for Ru1–Mo2C NSs.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The SEM image in Fig. 1b indicates that the curled nanosheet structure was maintained for the R u _ { 1 } – M o _ { 2 } C NSs...

nodes.characterization_summary: HAADF-STEM visualizes nanosheet structure with pores and holes; discrete light dots indicate Ru single atoms.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The high-angle annular dark-field scanning transmission electron microscopy (HAADF-STEM) images in Fig. 1c... shows discrete light dots encircled in red, which indicate Ru atoms that exist as single atom sites.

nodes.characterization_summary: STEM-EDS elemental mapping shows nanosheet mainly composed of Mo, C, and small amount of Ru.
nodes.evidence_snippet: Scanning transmission electron microscopy energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (STEM-EDS) elemental mapping in Fig. 1d demonstrated that the nanosheet was mainly composed of Mo and C elements, as well as a small amount of Ru...

nodes.characterization_summary: Ru content in Ru1–Mo2C NSs is 0.41 wt%.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The amount of Ru in the R u _ { 1 } – M o _ { 2 } C NSs was 0.41 wt%, which was identified by the inductively coupled plasma and atomic emission spectrum (ICP-AES) results.

nodes.characterization_summary: Lattice spacings of 0.206 nm ascribed to (200) crystal facets of Mo2C.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The lattice spacings in Fig. 1e were 0.206 nm, and were ascribed to the (200) crystal facets of M o _ { 2 } C.

nodes.characterization_summary: Characteristic diffraction peaks at 37.47°, 43.66°, and 63.44° indexed to (111), (200), and (220) planes of Mo2C (PDF#15-0457); no Ru metal peaks observed.
nodes.evidence_snippet: In Fig. S5 (ESI†), the characteristic diffraction peaks at 37.47°, 43.66°, and 63.44° are indexed to the (111), (200), and (220) crystal planes of PDF#15-0457, respectively. For the R u _ { 1 } – M o _ { 2 } C sample, no peak ascribed to metal Ru particles was observed...

nodes.characterization_summary: Ru 3p3/2 at 461.92 eV and 3p1/2 at 484.1 eV (lower than RuO2); Mo 3d deconvoluted to Mo2+ (228.91/232.06 eV), Mo4+ (230.01/233.15 eV), Mo6+ (232.08/235.26 eV); negative Mo 3d shift indicates charge transfer from Ru to Mo2C.
nodes.evidence_snippet: In the Ru 3p XPS spectra, there were two peaks of 3p3/2 and 3p1/2 in R u _ { 1 } – M o _ { 2 } C at approximately 461.92 eV and 484.1 eV, respectively, which were much lower than those of R u O _ { 2 } (464.12 and 486.33 eV)... The binding energies for M o _ { 2 } C can be deconvoluted into six peaks... The slight negative shift of the Mo 3d peaks for R u _ { 1 } – M o _ { 2 } C in comparison to M o _ { 2 } C imply a charge transfer between M o _ { 2 } C and Ru.

nodes.characterization_summary: Mo K-edge absorption edge between Mo foil and MoO3; negative shift vs Mo2C indicates decreased Mo oxidation state.
nodes.evidence_snippet: As shown in Fig. 2c, the Mo K-edge XANES spectra demonstrate that the absorption edge of R u _ { 1 } – M o _ { 2 } C is located between that of Mo foil and M o O _ { 3 }...

nodes.characterization_summary: FT Mo K-edge EXAFS major peak at 1.42 Å (Mo-C, lower than Mo2C's 1.53 Å); second shell at 2.69 Å (Mo-M, M=Mo,Ru); WT shows Mo-C at 5.5 Å⁻¹ and Mo-M at 7.0 Å⁻¹.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The Fourier transform (FT) Mo K-edge extended X-ray absorption fine structure (EXAFS) of R u _ { 1 } – M o _ { 2 } C exhibited a major peak located at approximately 1.42 Å... From the WT contour plots of R u _ { 1 } – M o _ { 2 } C, the maximum intensity values at 5.5 and 7.0 Å⁻¹ corresponded to the Mo–C and Mo–M...

nodes.characterization_summary: Electrochemical double-layer capacitance Cdl = 31.8 mF cm⁻², proportional to ECSA.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The value of C _ { d l } for the R u _ { 1 } – M o _ { 2 } C NSs was 31.8 mF cm⁻², which is much higher than those of M o _ { 2 } C NSs (3.49 mF cm⁻²)...
